question: What claim about the speaker's intention is at stake in promising to speak the method of names to the beautiful-eyed one and bidding her to hear?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names of them.
The addressee is bidden to hear.
The address is to the beautiful-eyed one.
inference: The speaker promises to disclose the method of their names and calls on the addressee to hear it.
uncertainties: The list of names is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear, you, O beautiful-eyed one.
